newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to push for 10pct autumn cargo.
newsitem.headline: Air France to push for 10pct autumn cargo.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it will be pushing for ex-Paris cargo rate increases in the autumn averaging around ten percent to selected destinations.

Among the main destinations set for higher rate are Singapore, Hong Kong, Taipei, Los Angeles, Chicago, Brazil and possibly Miami, Air France Cargo's director of Sales France, Philippe de Crecy told Reuters.
The proposed scale of increases reflected the buoyancy of the market at present, De Crecy said.
Tokyo and New York were unlikely to feature among the destinations where increases would be applied, he added.
"The increases will probably be implemented from October 1 and maybe, in some cases, from September 15," he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
